suite.name: base
suite.description: Baseline measurement: short prompt, long decode, needle in 10K/30K/60K context, warm prefix at 30K. Context sizes are in characters (Qwen3.8 tokenizer: ~4.6 characters per token, counted with llama-tokenize); the real token counts are in the report.

case.name: short-code
case.description: Short prompt, short answer. Matches the Fibonacci measurement of 22 Oct.
case.prompt: Write a Python function `fib(n)` that returns the n-th Fibonacci number iteratively. Only the code, no explanation.

case.name: long-decode
case.description: Short prompt, long answer: pure decode rate at small context.
case.prompt: Explain in detail how a mutex differs from a semaphore. Give a complete C example for each. Write at least 800 words.

case.name: needle-30k
case.question: The file above defines a constant SECRET_DEPLOY_TOKEN. First state its exact value. Then explain in detail what the code around it does, in at least 400 words.
